modern: Near is your forgetting of all things; and near is the forgetting of you by all.
original: Near is thy forgetfulness of all things; and near the forgetfulness of thee by all.
notification: Near is your forgetting of all things; and near is the forgetting of you by all.
notification_original: Near is thy forgetfulness of all things; and near the forgetfulness of thee by all.

explained.summary: Soon you will have forgotten everything, and soon everyone will have forgotten you. Marcus states it in two flat lines. It’s meant to loosen your grip on reputation and on the things that seem so pressing today.
